templates.name: Portfolio
templates.desc: A personal site whose name is built from thousands of particles that react to your pointer, then scatter into a galaxy as you scroll. Projects, about and contact.
templates.note: A portfolio whose name is made of thousands of particles. Move the pointer through them, then scroll: they scatter into a galaxy.
templates.best: Designers, developers and freelancers who want to be remembered
templates.try: Move your pointer over the name, scroll to turn it into a galaxy, then open a project.

templates.name: Professional Portfolio
templates.desc: A working portfolio for analysts and consultants: a chaos-to-clarity scroll intro, a searchable skills library, case studies, sample deliverables, interactive decision scenarios and a process puzzle.
templates.note: A working portfolio: scroll intro, 42-skill library, case studies, sample deliverables, decision scenarios and a process puzzle. Press / to search.
templates.best: Analysts, consultants and job seekers who want to show how they think
templates.try: Skip the intro, search the skills library, then open a case study.

templates.name: Gift Shop
templates.desc: A complete online shop: cart, UPI and card payments, orders, GST invoices, coupons and rewards, and an Owner view where the owner runs the shop while the brand and tax details stay locked.
templates.note: A complete shop: cart, test payments, orders, invoices and a locked Owner view. Everything you change stays in this browser.
templates.best: Small online shops: gifts, candles, crafts, food and more
templates.try: Add a gift to the cart and check out with the test payment, then open Owner view.

templates.name: 3D House Shop
templates.desc: The same full shop, opening with a scroll-driven walk through a 3D house. Products sit in the rooms; visitors step in and shop.
templates.note: The same shop, opening with a scroll-driven 3D walk through a house. Use Home page above to switch between the walk and the gift shop.
templates.best: Shops that want a memorable, walk-through first impression
templates.try: Choose Home page, Foyer, scroll through the house, then open Owner view.

templates.name: Scroll Openings
templates.desc: Three scroll-driven homepage openings: plaster arches that light up, a candle poured and lit, a 3D home tour. Drop one into any site.
templates.note: Three scroll-driven openings. Use Opening above to switch, then scroll the homepage.
templates.best: Shops and brands that want a cinematic scroll opening
templates.try: Switch Opening above, scroll the home page, then open Owner view.

templates.name: Product Website
templates.desc: For makers and factories: a scroll-controlled seed-to-bottle film, online ordering, dealer enquiries and quality records.
templates.note: Scroll the film: field, sunflower, seeds, press, oil, bottles. Then orders, dealer enquiries and quality records.
templates.best: Factories and makers who sell to dealers and shops: oil, spices, grains
templates.try: Scroll the film from seed to bottle, then send a dealer enquiry.

templates.name: Pixel Intros
templates.desc: Four opening effects for any website: a tear-open pixel cloth, pictures that build pixel by pixel, a pinned browser tour and a tear-off price tag.
templates.note: Four effects: tear the cloth, scroll to build the pictures, scroll the pinned browser tour, and tear off the price tag.
templates.best: Any site that needs a striking opening effect
templates.try: Tear the cloth, scroll to build the pictures, then try the tear-off price tag.

templates.name: Records Dashboard
templates.desc: A dashboard for student, staff or customer records: add, edit, delete, search, sort, filter and export, with charts and a phone-friendly layout.
templates.note: Add, edit, delete, search, sort and export records. Try the Add button, then reload: your changes stay in this browser.
templates.best: Schools, clinics and small offices that keep lists of people
templates.try: Add a student, search, sort, export, then reload: your changes stay.
